name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast. It’s the only option that survives color inversion and reduced-motion modes without breaking visual clarity. The trade-off is slightly larger touch targets on mobile, but that improves usability for everyone.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 4.5:1 still fails on monochrome displays where the ring blends into busy backgrounds. A 2px ring at 7:1 contrast survives monochrome but risks blending into low-contrast interfaces. Settle it with a user test: measure ring visibility on monochrome and low-contrast backgrounds for both options.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 2px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It survives monochrome displays and low-contrast interfaces without relying on color inversion, which is critical for users with monochrome setups. The trade-off is a thinner ring that may be harder to spot on high-contrast backgrounds, but the 7:1 ratio ensures visibility even when colors invert or motion reduces. User tests will confirm if the trade-off is acceptable.

name: Reader
text: A 2px ring at 7:1 contrast risks disappearing on patterned backgrounds where the ring’s thinness gets lost in texture. A 3px ring at 6:1 contrast survives monochrome, low-contrast, and patterned backgrounds without relying on inversion. Test both rings on monochrome, low-contrast, and patterned backgrounds with users who rely on focus visibility—measure time to locate the ring and error rates.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with 1px outer glow (white) — deliver a tested, documented focus style in EXCAVA’s design system; owner: Ramp.
